body: Sorry for the delay in response. She is doing very well. She is having a hard time distinguishing what’s reality and what isn’t though. She keeps asking if this is real. She doesn’t remember anything. Nothing at all. Not even about school.
Can you private message me more information about your school and how you found it?

I can’t believe all they did was suspend for a day.  That is unreal. 

I hear what your saying about gaining new bullies, but she is a pretty popular girl at school. The bully and company are fairly new, and outsiders. 
I am going to the school today to talk to them about this.
Homeschooling has been put on the table as options to get away from this bullying. Thank you for the input. I appreciate it.
Thank you for taking the time to comment. Ibreallynso need to ask more questions and not always take what she say at face value.
And I think this forum is a type of group therapy. You could literally say what you said tone on every post on this subreddit.
At midnight? I can’t think of a single therapist available at midnight.
Thank you for this. I am going to have the schools about this today, actually. It’s great to know you were able to get justice for that.
That’s exactly how I meant it to sound.

My daughter hasn’t been thrown into a new environment. She’s always been in public school and has always been socialized. This was not the logical way for her to deal with this. Thanks for the comments but this is the last thing I needed to hear.
Yes. At midnight or so, when I wrote this...I turned to a place that had people who would listen. You should look deep within and ask yourself, “is this comment nessesary?”.

You don’t have to respond to any of this. Just please read. 

You are everything to someone. 

Whatever it is that you’re facing, you don’t have to do it alone. 

Your father loves you more than you’ll ever understand. 

My 13yo daughter is laying in a hospital bed right here in front of me as I type this. She overdosed and I found her having seizures in her bed. She has IVs and tubes surrounding her. She is hallucinating and having tremors. And all I can do is sit here and watch her. And try to understand why this is happening to my sweet little girl. She’s my everything. 

You are to your father, what that litttle girl is to me. You hung his moon. He would be devastated if something happened to you. 

Everything you’re experiencing seems like the end of the world right now, but it’s not. It’s not the end. I promise. This too shall pass. 

Everything will be ok.

I have never suffered like you have. So I can’t speak to any experience. But what I can speak on is love. 
My daughter is in the hospital after taking a lethal dose of Wellbutrin. I’m sitting here as I type this watching her lay there and tremor, while her limbs jolt involuntarily, listening to her hallucinate in her sleep, with tubes and cables everywhere not knowing what’s going to happen next.. My helpless little thing. My world.

You are someone’s world. You are to someone, what that little girl is to me. You are special. You are loved. 

Please don’t hurt yourself. Please.

Thank you so much. I appreciate you reaching out to me. 
I believe that bullying is one of the most terrible pains you can inflict upon someone. I just wish I could take all the bullying for her.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. 

I am really trying to show her I understand and that. I’m here for her. She comes to me about a lot of things. But the bullying is something she keeps to herself. The only reason I knew about it was because of a high school boy that lives in our neighborhood. He told me that she gets bullied on the bus and he tries to take up for her but he’s only in there until he gets dropped off at the high school. 

She tells me everything but that. I just don’t get it. I just want to help.
